unknown_states_in_history.note: Time-sensitive — re-evaluate once analysis timeframe is set.

historical_unknown_columns.note: Time-sensitive — re-evaluate once analysis timeframe is set.

short_dwell_spans.note: Short dwell spans are likely accidental moves. Consider ignoring these when evaluating regressions.

future_column_timestamps.note: Items with future 'entered' timestamps produce negative days_in_current_column. Fix the source timestamp in ADO or exclude the affected column span.
